job_text:
QA Automation Engineer - Vectorline Software

About the role
Our quality team keeps releases safe for millions of users. You will build and maintain the automated tests that run on every pull request.

Requirements
- Experience writing automated tests in Python
- Familiarity with Selenium for browser testing
- Understanding of REST API testing
- Experience working in a CI/CD pipeline
- Attention to detail when reproducing bugs

Nice to have
- Experience with performance testing tools
- Familiarity with Docker
- Exposure to mobile test automation

Benefits
- Competitive salary
- Four weeks paid time off
